seo.title: Shoulder Press
seo.description: Single-user outdoor shoulder press (FFE006S) from FunPlay's CoreCraft Fun Fitness range. Body-weight workout for parks, societies and terrace gyms. Get a quote.

data.description: The single Shoulder Press in our Fun Fitness range has one orange seat with a backrest on a grey post, and two handles that reach forward above the user's head. The user sits, pushes the handles upward and lowers them under control, working the shoulders and arms with body weight as the load. A single machine fits where space is tight, such as a terrace gym or a small society garden, and pairs well with a leg machine nearby. The listed colour is Play Orange. Ask us for its drawing and warranty terms with your quote. We will confirm the Shoulder Press warranty in your quote; standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

The user sits, pushes the handles upward and lowers them under control, working the shoulders and arms with body weight as the load. A single machine fits where space is tight, such as a terrace gym or a small society garden, and pairs well with a leg machine nearby. The listed colour is Play Orange. Ask us for its drawing and warranty terms with your quote. We will confirm the Shoulder Press warranty in your quote; standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

The pressing arm turns on a pivot near the top of the post, which is the main part to inspect and grease. A one-seat Shoulder Press can be fixed self-standing on a firm slab or grouted. Leave clear headroom above the handles and space in front of the seat.
